name: rq6-test
description:
RQ6, the final test on the main sets, run once: the model chosen on development data by
the rule fixed on 2026-10-22 (JOURNAL.md), the union of the XLM-R token classifier and
GLiNER focal loss, both trained with WikiGoldSK and SlavicNER added and held-out text
dropped, config seed (decision of 2026-10-14), against NameTag 3 multilingual (the
headline opponent, decision 2A). The main sets are fair to both sides (decision 1):
full REDACT (496 Czech records, never trained on), CNEC 2.0 etest and UNER-SK test (both
sides trained on their train splits). The verdict is python -m experiments verdict on the
first comparison (decisions 2B and 3). NameTag 3 Czech, zero-shot GLiNER and the two
parts of the union are reported as data. All own models trained on fobos (NVIDIA L40S).
